Autoclip MVP. This repo automates video clip cutting and highlight extraction from long four videos, so you can then sell to creators and live streamers to increase their visibility.
Remotion. This allows you to automate the creation of repetitive videos through templates and AI editing, basically giving you the ability to edit any video for short form.
You can then sell this to media companies, marketing firms, and creators.
Open Hands. This is an autonomous AI software developer. You can then package this and sell it to small and medium businesses as a software developer for their tech.
Persona Live. This repo creates portrait image generation for live streams in real time. It allows you to create an AI influencer with AI avatars running live streams.
Red Ink. This creates text and image generation optimized for Red Note, which allows you to arbitrage traffic for e-commerce for Asian social networks.
Moo Moo AI Novel. This repo gives you an AI assistant for mass writing books, plots, and novels. You can then sell these to publishing platforms.
If you want a guy with the full list of them, just like the video and comment area and I'll send it to you.
